title: The Web began with a problem of sharing knowledge
summary: Tim Berners-Lee invented the World Wide Web at CERN in 1989. In 1993, CERN made the software freely available.
body: The initial problem was practical: scientists needed to share information across computers and institutions. Berners-Lee proposed an internet-based hypertext system in 1989. CERN made the Web software available on a royalty-free basis on 30 April 1993.
question: What information in your own work is difficult to connect, and what would make it easier to share?
